purpose: Curated, first-party-evidenced physical venue decisions. Source rows remain immutable; do not infer public Mass from upstream flags.
review_policy: Only a dated current official witness with a specific physical location and explicit Mass schedule may promote a public Find venue. Exception/relocation and seasonal schedules must retain effective dates. Unverified research leads remain outside Find.

witness.title: Durban Priory — local Mass venue notice

decisions.review_note: Local district apostolate separates the transitional Sunday site at Berea from weekday Masses at new Kloof premises. Do not transfer the Sunday timetable to Kloof or assume fixed weekday times.
